title: Active Developer Badge
body:
Active Developer Badge - No Longer Available

The Active Developer Badge has been decommissioned and is no longer available to earn. Any Active Developer Badges that were previously displayed on user profiles have been removed.

Why was this change made?

We found that the Active Developer Badge created a heavy amount of support issues with little benefit to developers. We've made this decision to better align our developer recognition efforts with programs that more meaningfully celebrate our developer community.

What's next for developer recognition?

We're exploring new ways to recognize and showcase active developers through community events, featured developer showcases, and other initiatives in the Discord Developers server.

Stay connected

To stay up to date with the latest platform updates and developer news, join the Discord Developers server and subscribe to our developer announcements.

If you have questions or feedback about this change, please reach out to our Developer Support team.
